title: Agents on the Patch Path: Mining AI-Associated Security Remediation in GitHub Security Advisories
abstract: arXiv:2611.09808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly involved in software development, but their participation in real-world security remediation remains poorly understood. We investigate observable evidence of coding-agent involvement in commits referenced by reviewed GitHub Security Advisories (GHSAs), characterize the associated vulnerabilities, and examine review timing in relation to advisory disclosure routes.   We develop a local-Git mining pipeline that identifies agent evidence through known agent accounts, explicit commit-message attribution, repository instruction files, and agent configuration artifacts. Linking these findings to GHSA-referenced commits yields 469 valid candidate advisories across 189 repositories, including 448 with direct attribution and 21 supported only by repository-level evidence. translated_title: 补丁路径上的智能体：挖掘 GitHub 安全公告中与 AI 相关的安全修复
translated_abstract: 自主编码智能体越来越多地参与到软件开发中，但它们在真实世界安全修复中的参与情况仍然知之甚少。我们研究了经过审核的 GitHub 安全公告（GHSA）所引用的提交中编码智能体参与的可观测证据，刻画了相关漏洞的特征，并考察了代码审查时机与公告披露途径之间的关系。我们开发了一个基于本地 Git 的挖掘流水线，通过已知的智能体账号、明确的提交信息署名、仓库指令文件以及智能体配置工件来识别智能体证据。将这些发现与 GHSA 引用的提交关联后，得到了覆盖 189 个仓库的 469 条有效候选公告，其中 448 条具有直接署名，21 条仅由仓库级证据支持。Claude 是最常被观察到的工具家族，其次是 Copilot 和 Cursor。我们进一步将审查时机与其他披露方式（摘要在此处被截断）进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个本地 Git 挖掘流水线，首次系统性识别 GitHub 安全公告引用提交中编码智能体参与真实安全修复的证据，发现 189 个仓库中的 469 条候选公告，其中 Claude 是最常用的智能体工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a local-Git mining pipeline to systematically identify coding-agent involvement in real-world security remediation commits referenced by GitHub Security Advisories, uncovering 469 candidate advisories across 189 repositories with Claude being the most frequently used agent tool.
